# The Surrogate

> The Surrogate is an immersive AI encounter by SNEAKAR XR. SURROGATE Oracle
> is a voice-led experience where seekers explore identity, memory, culture,
> and the future through a live artificial presence.

## Canonical

- https://thesurrogate.me/

## About

The Surrogate combines realtime dialogue, a persistent seeker archive, and a
visual Oracle for an experiential encounter rather than a conventional search
or productivity tool.

Preferred names:

- Product: The Surrogate
- Experience: SURROGATE Oracle
- Studio: SNEAKAR XR
